items.author: Musk
items.text: In A SpaceX-Tesla Merger, Elon Musk May Be The Big Winner. What It May Mean For Other Investors.
items.summary_cn: Musk 旗下 SpaceX 与 Tesla 潜在合并传闻，Musk 或为最大赢家，间接利好 kcn 持有的 SpaceX 相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla Shares Suffer Slow Summer After SpaceX IPO, Earnings Rout
items.summary_cn: SpaceX IPO 后资金分流及 Tesla 业绩不佳致股价承压，对 kcn 持有 SpaceX 系标的情绪面略有影响。

items.author: Musk
items.text: 'You can't break the fundamental laws of physics': T-Mobile CFO says he's not worried about Elon Musk's cellular ambitions
items.summary_cn: T-Mobile CFO 表示不惧 Musk 的蜂窝通信野心，间接涉及 SpaceX/Starlink 业务竞争格局。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Boring Co. turns to Middle East for expansion in reaching $23 billion valuation
items.summary_cn: Musk 的 Boring Co. 估值达 230 亿美元并拓展中东市场，未上市标的，与 kcn 持仓无直接关联。
